tasks.text: To type correctly, we must use all ten fingers.
In the home row, your fingers are on the ASDF and JKL; keys.
We hit the space bar with our thumb.
We must hold down the Shift key for capital letters.
We can start a new line or paragraph with the Enter key.
We can fix errors with the Backspace and Delete keys.
The English keyboard layout is based on the QWERTY sequence.
The numeric keypad helps in quick calculation.
Try not to look at the keyboard while typing.
The at symbol is used in every email address.
